title: Run state
description: Internal state the Actor carries between runs: cached geocoding results and email digest send history.

geocodeCache.title: Geocode cache
geocodeCache.description: Place name/address to coordinates, cached so repeat runs don't re-query Nominatim for places already resolved. Only successful lookups are cached — a failed one is retried next run rather than replaying the failure forever.

digestState.title: Email digest state
digestState.description: Per-subscriber (hashed email) last-sent timestamp and fingerprints of already-sent events, so a frequently-scheduled run only actually emails once the chosen digest frequency has elapsed, and never repeats an event.
